## Details

<a id="title_mow_logo"></a>
### [`title_mow_logo`](../../../../src/title/title_mower.asm#L6) `$83D5`

*label*

Gordon (sprite 0, frames $c0-$c4) pushes the mower (sprite 1, frame $c5) from left to right along row 6. Each column of grass becomes mown grass ($59). Four columns behind the mower, the letters of the logo appear. Fire jumps to the setup screen.

- **Jumped to from:** [`title_screen`](title_screen.md#title_screen)
